campaignSource.maker: Democratic Party (not personally attributed to nominee)

candidatePledges.locator: 2020 platform, Strengthening the U.S. Postal Service, paragraph beginning 'The U.S. Postal Service'
candidatePledges.paraphrase: Seek repeal of the statutory retiree-health-benefit prefunding mandate imposed on USPS.
candidatePledges.criterion: Federal law repeals the specified prefunding mandate.
candidatePledges.uncertainty: Legislative enactment documented; attribution to the governing party, implementation, durability and independent review remain unadjudicated.

candidatePledges.locator: 2020 platform, Strengthening the U.S. Postal Service, paragraph beginning 'Democrats will protect'
candidatePledges.paraphrase: Preserve six-day mail delivery and the universal-service obligation.
candidatePledges.criterion: Federal law codifies six-day integrated delivery; separate outcome evidence needed for actual coverage.
candidatePledges.uncertainty: Codification alone cannot prove six-day delivery everywhere, or measure long-run durability.

candidatePledges.locator: 2020 platform, Supporting Working Families, paragraph beginning 'Democrats will make major investments'
candidatePledges.paraphrase: Significantly increase the Child and Dependent Care Tax Credit.
candidatePledges.criterion: Statutory increase in available child/dependent-care credit relative to pre-election law; duration coded separately.
candidatePledges.uncertainty: 2021 increase was temporary, so enactment and durable delivery must be coded separately.

officialEvents.name: American Rescue Plan Act 2021
officialEvents.locator: Section 9631, Child and Dependent Care Tax Credit
officialEvents.fact: 2021 tax-year expansion of child and dependent care tax credit.

officialEvents.name: Postal Service Reform Act 2022
officialEvents.locator: Postal retiree health benefits and six-day delivery provisions
officialEvents.fact: Reformed retiree health prefunding and codified six-day delivery; bipartisan legislative history must be considered.

officialEvents.name: USPS FY2022 results
officialEvents.locator: Paragraph beginning 'The enactment of the Postal Service Reform Act'
officialEvents.fact: USPS reports repeal of annual future-retiree-health prefunding and a one-time noncash $57.0 billion accounting benefit; not cash expenditure.

officialEvents.name: IRS historical 2021 child/dependent care credit guidance
officialEvents.locator: For tax year 2021, maximum eligible expense
officialEvents.fact: IRS describes 2021-only maximum eligible expenses of $8,000 for one and $16,000 for two or more qualifying persons, subject to credit-rate and eligibility rules.

officialEvents.name: Laken Riley Act
officialEvents.fact: Adds specified mandatory detention categories. Do not equate to broad 2024 border-security pledges or infer comprehensive enforcement outcomes.

officialEvents.name: Budget 2025 Implementation Act, No. 1 (C-15), Canada
officialEvents.fact: Statutory authority for payments up to C$11.5 billion for Build Canada Homes; authorization ceiling, not cash spent.
